summary: Full E2E test of community habit tracker. Backend pytest 8/8 passed (auth, habits CRUD/visibility, ticks + streak logic, 403 for non-owner ticks, 404 for private habit, community listing, comments). Frontend Playwright flow with two users all passed: signup/signin -> /my-habits, wrong password error, top nav + sidebar links on all pages, sign out -> /signin and protected redirect, share checkbox unticked by default, Shared/Private badges, 7 YYYY-MM-DD checkboxes (today + 6 prior), ticks persist after reload, Days done/Current streak update correctly, non-owner sees disabled checkboxes, private habit hidden from Community and shows 'Habit not found' to others, community card shows name/owner/when/days, comments posted by Bob visible with author name to owner Alice. Mobile top nav OK.

minor.issue: Accepts any valid date (including future dates or dates outside last 7 days). UI only exposes last 7 days, so this is not user-facing.
No brute-force lockout (playbook item). User asked for no extra features, so this is optional.

issues: The 'Habit added' toast sits on top of the top-nav links for a few seconds. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. Consider listing explicit origins (playbook recommendation). Auth works through the Bearer header either way.
habit_out does a separate user lookup for every habit (N+1 queries) on the community and my-habits lists. Fine at MVP scale.
bcrypt hashing, httpOnly+secure cookie, and _id exclusion are all implemented correctly.
test_credentials: No seeded users; test users created dynamically (TEST_*/ui_*/zed_* @example.com)
seed_data_creation: Created test users and habits (TEST_Run, TEST_Read, Shared Walk, Private Habit) plus one comment
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/. Frontend computes dates in local time; the backend stores YYYY-MM-DD strings. Sidebar fades in, so wait about 1s before checking that it is visible.
